facts.fact: Digital Mag says documents generated in the Cote d'Ivoire Identite app are authenticated through a certified ONECI system (CEV), and the app was released on 5 August 2025.

Digital Mag says the Cote d'Ivoire Identite app, built with ONECI, Mastercard and Paynah, holds a person's national ID card (CNI) on a phone behind fingerprint or face login, and became available for download on 5 August 2025.
